title: Tolerance analysis of a lossy WR-90 line 30 ± 5 mm long (uniform): the spread of its loss and the yield of |S21| ≥ −0.9 dB
source: A matched lossy line's loss in dB is linear in its length, |S21|dB = −8.686 α L with 8.686 α = 0.030100 dB/mm at 10 GHz (lossy-line's closed form: γ = √((π/a)² − k0² εr(1 − j tan δ)), D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3). With L uniform in 30 ± 5 mm: the mean |S21| is that at 30 mm, −0.90301 dB; its σ is 0.030100 × 5/√3 = 0.086892 dB; and the share meeting |S21| ≥ −0.9 dB (L ≤ 29.900 mm) is (29.900 − 25)/10 = 0.49000. Evaluated separately from EMCraft's code; the draws are random, so each quantity's tolerance is three standard errors of its estimate from 40 draws.

quantities.reason: three standard errors of a mean of 40 uniform draws (σ/√40 = 0.0137 dB), with the solve's own 0.005 dB
three standard errors of a sample σ of 40 uniform draws: √((μ4/σ⁴ − 1)/4N) = √(0.8/160) = 7 % each
three standard errors of a share of 40 draws, √(p(1 − p)/40) = 0.079
a count: every draw is a valid line, none fails
